tei:div.tei:p: "$ (233)༄༅// rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa'i rtags tshad kyi yi ge bzhugs so/// /

(234)༄༅// na mo gu ra we/ zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor bsgoms pa'i rtags tshad la 'phros nas rtags kyi rnam bzhag rag pa rnams bshad par bya'o// 'di dag kyang rtsa ba rnams rgyud 'grel las gsal bar gsungs shing*/ brgyud pa gong ma rnams kyis 'di dag mtha' dag nyams myong gis grub par mdzad la/ da lta'i bar du yang yan lag dang po dngos dang gzhan rnams rjes mthun pa'i dbang du byas na/ nyams myong gi gtso bo gtso bo rnams la rtags thon pa dang yon tan skyes pa'i rgyun ma chad pa'i rim pa can yin no// de yang bod yul gyi gdams pa chos gzhan rnams kyi nyams myong rtags tshad rnams da ltar bsgom pa'i tshe/ bshad tshod dang mthun mi mthun ci rigs yod cing*/ chos 'di rnams la rtags rnams 'khrul med can du 'byung ba ni/ rgyud dang sems 'grel skor gsum nas man ngag gi rtsa ba thams cad lhag chad med par gsungs pas/ gdams ngag 'di ni rdo rje 'chang gi dgongs pa zur ma nyams pa yin la/ gzhan rnams (235)la ni sems 'grel skor gsum lta bu'i dbang po med cing*/ rgyud tshig rnams kyang zhal mi gsal zhing gab par yod pas brgyud pa mang po zhig brgyud pa las man ngag gi zur nyams pa'i rgyu las yin no gsungs so// de la sngon 'gro dben gsum gyi skabs su mthong nyams dang lus nyams sogs ni ma nges pa sna tshogs 'byung*/ dben gsum dang sor sdud kyi skabs ci rigs su/ lus gnad mdun du bub na snying ga'i dbus kyi nang mdun gyi rlung dang phrad pas shes pa hol le ba 'byung*/ g.yas su yo na me dang phrad pas 'tshub long ba dang*/ g.yon du yo na chu dang phrad pas nyog ge ba dang*/ rgyab tu yo na sa dang phrad pas bying zhing sra 'thas pa'i nyams 'byung*/ de dag spangs te sgal tshigs bsrangs pas snying lte bar gyi rtsa 'drongs pas srog rlung 'ching*/ rdo rje skyil krung dang 'og tshags legs por byas pas thur sel dang*/

mgrin pa dgug pas gyen rgyu dang*/ gsus pa mnyam dgang du shugs la yang 'byung ba byed (236)kyang dgos te des mnyam gnas dang*/ lta stangs kyis mig tu rgyu ba'i rlung dang*/ mgrin pa bkug nas so mchu rang so dang*/ lce rtse yar rkan la sbyar bas rna ba'i rtsa yang khyur te 'ong bas rna ba dang lce ba'i rlung 'ching ba dang*/ sbyor ba de dang rlung sna nas dal bus btang bas sna'i rlung dang*/ khu tshur brla bzhag lus grims lhod ran par byas pas lus dbang la rgyu ba'i rlung dang*/ thams cad bsdoms pas khyab byed kyi rlung 'ching ste/ de yang lus gnad kho nas 'ching thub pa rang ta ma yin mod/ lus gnad dang dmigs pa sbyar bas yin no// de ltar bsgoms pas/ sems nyams gtso che ba'i dbang du byas na/ nyams gnas skabs dang po ni/ sems skad cig kyang mi gnas shing rnam rtog sngar bas mang ba 'phro rgod ches che ba 'byung*/ 'ga' zhig gcig rting la gcig breng ma chad cing rigs mi 'dra ba sha stag 'byung ba'ang yod/ 'ga' zhig yul gcig la brten pa nyid rnam 'gyur mi 'dra tsam gyis yang yang dran yong ba'ang yod/ da sgom mi skye ba yin nam snyam pa dang*/ 'di bas gzhan zhig byas na dga' la snyam pa yang 'byung*/ de ni sngon sgom ma byas pa'i dus na rnam rtog mang yang kha phyir bltas su song nas ngo ma shes/ 'dir kha nang log gis bltas pas 'gyur ba la 'gyu ba rig shes byung ba tsom yin kyi/ rnam rtog sngar las mang du song ba min/ gzhan yang skabs der phar cher la lus gnad ma 'byongs pas lus kyang na zug che/ dbugs 'thums pa dang 'dar ba 'byung*/ sems kyang tshig pa za ba dang*/ gzhan du 'gro 'dod pa dang*/ gu dog pa'i rnam pa (237)sngar gyi nad gzhi rnying pa yod na ldang ba snyam byed/ de ni cung zad sems zin pa'i 'bras bu ste/ g.yo ba zhes bya ba'i nyams yin la/ dpe ri gzar gyi 'bab chu dang 'dra'o// gnas skabs gnyis pa ni/

de dag la skyon yon dga' sdug gang du yang ma bltas par bsgoms pas/ snga ma ltar rnam rtog mang po yong 'phro la cung zad re zhi mal song ba dang*/ lus dang dbugs kyang bde ba snyam byed/ de'i 'phro la sngar bzhin rnam rtog ldang zhing*/ lus dang dbugs kyang mi bde ba skye/ de ni thob pa zhes bya ba'i nyams te/ dpe bya tsi tsi mo'am/ rong khung dog pa'i 'bab chu dang 'dra'o// gsum pa ni da dung bsgoms pas mgo dang ro stod lji ba tsam 'byung*/ sngar las rnam rtog de phra ru song ba snyam byed cing shugs chung la/ 'phral rang la yal 'gro ba me stag gnam du yar ba lta bu dang*/ res 'ga' rnam rtog 'char tshad pa la zlog /res 'ga' rnam rtog mi 'gyur bar har re tshom me gsal cha dwangs cha ngar cha med pa la lus yong*// de skabs su hur phyung ngar bton te bsgom pa gal che/ des shes pa gsal dwangs can la lhan lhan gnas pa 'ong*/ de 'phro la rnam rtog thol lo lo skye de ltar spel mar 'byung ste/ lus nyams ngag nyams sngar bas ches 'jam zhing bde ba'i mgo zin te/ goms pa zhes bya ba'i nyams yin la/ dpe mi rgan po'i spyod lam dang*/ ri drung gi rdzing bu'am sbal pa mchod pa dang 'dra'o// bzhi pa ni/ da dung yun bsrings te bsgoms pas rnam rtog chig skyer ba dang*/ gnyis bstud gsum bstud thol thol ba 'byung*/ phal cher rtse gcig tu 'jam nyal le (238)gsal seng nge gnas/ lus nyams phal cher bde cham pa 'byung*/ rlung yang phal cher 'jam zhing bde/ res 'ga' sna sgo'i rlung gi reg bya dang sgra shin tu gsal bas sems gnas su mi ster bar sun pa snyam byed/ res 'ga' rnam rtog 'gyu 'gyu 'dra yang ngos bzung med par lhan ne gnas/ res 'ga' sems btang yang mi 'gro ste/ de ni brten pa'i nyams zhes bya ba yin/ dpe rus sbal mkhar gzhong du bcug pa dang*/ mtsho chung ser bus bskyod pa dang*/ lcags sbugs su chu blug pa lta bu'o// lnga pa ni da dung 'bad de bsgoms pas snga ma las kyang lus nyams ngag nyams bde zhing lus yod pa mi shes/

rlung rgyu ba mi tshor ba dang*/ shes kyang bde sdug med pa'i btang snyoms la gnas te sems mi 'phro ba dang*/ 'ga' zhig brtags na shes ma brtags na mi shes pa'ang 'byung*/ sems zhi gnas gcig tu mer gyis song nas/ sems gzhag na sdod/ btang na 'gro/ dgos dus sleb nas rang dbang thob/ sgra drag po sogs phyi'i rkyen byung ba dang*/ nang gi rtsol pas sad par byas na ma gtogs thun re 'khyongs pa 'byung ste/ mthar phyin pa'i nyams zhes bya ba/ dpe rgyal po 'khor la dbang bsgyur ba dang*/ ri bo chen po lta bu dang*/ mtsho chen rlabs dang bral ba lta bu'o// de ltar yang g.yo thob goms brtan mthar phyin te/ bsam gtan lam gyi skye tshul yin// zhes gsungs/ yang nyams skye tshul lnga po de dag la rim pas/ rnam rtog ngos 'dzin gyi nyams/ ngal gso'i nyams/ thang chad kyi nyams/ rlabs bcas kyi nyams/ rlabs dang (239)bral ba'i nyams zhes gsungs/ lnga pa 'di 'od gsal rtags bcu'i steng du gnas shing brtan pa thob na/ rkyen drag pos kyang sgom la 'du 'bral mi 'byung ste/ 'bras bu 'od gsal la sbyor thub gsung ngo*// de dag la res 'ga' sems mi gsal ba dwangs cha ma rnyed pa 'byung ste/ de ni zhi gnas lteng sor grags pa byed pa dang 'dren pa'i skyon yin/ phyis skabs gcig na de lta bu yang byung rgyal du bskyangs pas mi rtog pa skyon med du 'gro ba yod kyang*/ re zhig shes pa grims cha thon par byas la sbyang dgos/ de dag gi bar bar du 'dod yon gyi g.yeng ba sngar byas dran pa ni mi rgod pa dang*/ phyis byed 'dod ni 'dod pa la 'dun pa dang*/ bya nyes phra mo tshun chod la'ang 'gyod pa skye ba dang*/ chos dang bya ba gang la yang yid gnyis the tshom mang po 'byung ste/ sgom la bzhag nas rig pa dwags po byung ba'i tshe/ de dag gang rung zhig bskyar gyin bsgyar gyis blo la 'char pas sems la gnod par 'byung ste/ phyis skabs gcig na de lta bu yang byung rgyal du bskyangs pas gsal ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi 'gro ba grogs su 'gro ba cig yod kyang*/

re shig ched du spangs na legs pas/ de dag gi yul rnams bden med sgyu ma lta bur shes pa dang*/ rgod 'dun la nges 'byung dang*/ 'gyod pa la spro ba bskyed pa dang*/ the tshom la blo thag bcad pa rnams lan kha yar shugs bskyed de bsgoms pas sel/ de dag ni dpen gsum dang por sdud kyi skabs su ci rigs par dgos so// dpen gsum dang thun mong ba rnams bshad zin to// da ni sor sdud kyi nyams rnams (240)bshad par bya ste/ nang du rlung sems 'gags pa las rtags bcu 'char ba'i tshul ni/ shes rab kyi phyogs las rlung dbu mar 'dus pas du ba lta bu ste phyur pa dang*/ dug dang chags pa lta bu mer re ba dang*/ spos reng gi du ba lta bu khyur khyur 'gro ba dang*/ char sprin gsar pa 'dra ba dang*/ rmugs pa 'thibs ba lta bu 'byung zhing*/ kha dog ser dkar dmar nag ljang sngo khra bo sogs sna tshogs dang*/ kha dog gcig pa dang*/ gnyis ldan gsum ldan bzhi ldan lnga ldan la sogs pa sna tshogs dang*/ tshad kyang che chung ma nges pa brtan pa dang g.yo ba rgyu pa'i tshul kyang gcig tu ma nges pa 'byung ngo*// ngag nyams rlung thon dka' ba dang*/ lus nyams lus brji snyam byed/ snying ga la sogs pa nas gzhan gyis mnan pa'am btsir ba snyam byed pa 'byung*/ sems nyams bying rmugs shas che rmi nyams su du ba rlangs pa 'tshub ma rmugs pa sogs dang*/ sa'i 'og tu non pa dang*/ sa phug dang khung du nyal ba sogs 'byung*/ chu rlung dbu mar 'dus pas/ smig rgyu lta bu ste shig shig pa dang*/ chu bo lta bur rgyug pa dang*/ char zim rlung gis bskyod pa ltar hrib hrib ba 'byung*/ kha dog dang rgya che chung dang brtan g.yo la sogs pa gong du bshad pa ltar ma nges pa'o// lus nyams 'jam la mnyen/ lus bsil ba dang gang ltar 'dug kyang bde ba'i rnam pa 'byung sems nyams gnas pa dang rnam rtog res mos su 'byung zhing*/ bde mi bde res mos su 'char// rmi nyams su'ang chu bo dang char dang smig rgyu la sogs pa 'byung*// me rlung 'dus pas srin bu me khyer lta bu ste/

(241)'od phra mo tsim tsim mang po nam mkha' la skye zhing yal ba dang*/ 'phro zhing 'du ba dang*/ tog yar gyis 'gro ba 'byung*/ lus nyams drod che ba skabs su rdul dang bcas pa dang*/ bkres skom gyi snang ba 'byung*/ ngag nyams su dbug kha thung*/ sems nyams su shes pa gsal la 'phro zhing rtsub/ rmi nyams su me'i snang ba mang du 'byung*// rlung gi rlung 'dus pas mar me 'bar ba lta bu ste/ 'od tshad 'bring tsam gsal zhing*/ 'bar ba yun ring du gnas shing g.yo ba med pa dang*/ 'dar khril ba 'byung*/ 'phreng du bsgrigs pa dang*/ gcig tu cher 'bar ba dang*/ gcig rting la gcig 'byung ba sogs mdog dbyibs tshad sogs ma nges pa gong bzhin no// lus nyams yang zhing g.yo/ ngag nyams dbugs 'jam zhing dal/ dbugs phyi nang du 'gag pa snyam byed/ sems nyams yul yul ba dang*/ brjed ngas che ba dang*/ gtad med du cho lang nge 'byung*/ rmi nyams su rlung tshubs dang bya sogs lding ba/ rta sogs srog chags rgyug pa'i rnam pa 'byung ste mtshan rtags bzhi'o// de ltar bzhi dang*/ 'og tu 'chad pa'i thig le lnga ni shes rab phyogs kyi 'byung ba lnga 'dus pa yin pas/ khams lnga'i rlung 'dus pa zhes bya'o// 'di'i 'phros las nam mkha'i rlung 'dus na mchog gi cha lta bu'i rtags skabs 'dir 'byung ngo*// zhes gsungs la/ nyin mtshan gnyis kar gyi thun mong du nam mkha' sprin med pa lta bu'i rtags kyang 'byung ste/ 'di ni nyin rtags rnams 'char ba'i gzhi yin pas rtags bcu'i nang du logs su ma bgrangs pa (242)yin no// de yang skar khung gi bu ga lta bu dang*/ glo skar dang*/ mthongs ka dang*/ tshags se dang gra mig la sogs pa'i rnam pa 'byung zhing*/ mthar de dag gcig la gcig 'brel te/ je yangs je yangs su gyur nas/ nam mkha' mtha' dbus med par 'gro/ kha dog ma nges pa sogs gong dang 'dra/ 'on kyang nam mkha' lta bu'i rtags yin na gang mi sgrib cing dwangs pa zhig 'ong ngo*// thabs kyi phyogs ma rlung gi rlung dbu mar 'dus pas ser po 'bar ba'i rnams pa 'byung ste/

sprin med pa'i nam mkha' la me 'od kyis khyab pa dang*/ thab kyi me 'dra ba/ nag mes tshig pa lta bu'i rnams pa dang*/ me lce g.yas g.yon du rgyu ba sogs 'byung ste/ de yang ser po gtso bo yin la kha dog ma nges pa sna tshogs su 'byung ba sogs gong dang 'dra/ khyad par mun khang du dmar po shas che ba dang*/ sprin med kyis nam mkha' la dkar po shas che ba 'byung zhes gong ma 'ga' zhig gsung*/ de yang gcig tu ma nges par 'dug cing*/ lhab lhab 'bar ba'i rnam pa can du byung na/ kha dog ji ltar byung yang rung ser po 'bar ba'i phyogs mthun du bsdu'o// me rlung dbu mar 'dus pas dkar po 'bar ba zhes bya ba zla ba'i rnam pa 'char te 'od dkar po nang rgyug pa dang*/ glo skar dang*/ mthongs ka nas zla zer shar ba dang*/ tshes gcig nas bco lnga'i bar gyi zla ba'i gzugs sna tshogs pa dang*/ phyogs thams cad 'od zer dkar pos khyab pa sogs mdor na kha dog dkar po shas che ba'i sna tshogs pa dag 'byung ste/ skar mda' 'pho ba lta bu dang lcags sgrog ltar (243)sbrel ba dang skya ling ba sogs 'byung ngo*// chu rlung dbu mar 'dus pas dmar po 'bar ba nyi ma lta bu'i nyams 'byung ste/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mthong yang ri rtse khang logs sa mthil sogs la nyi 'od 'phog pa lta bu dang*/ glo skar dang thongs ka nas nyi mthongs byung ba 'dra ba dang*/ khun khang gi nang nyin mo ltar mthong ba dang*/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lta bu'i 'od zer gsal ba dbyibs dang kha dog ma nges pa dang*/ 'od zer gsal zhing 'tsher bas mi bzod pa dang*/ dmar sgo re ba 'od med pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor ljang khu dang ljang ser sogs 'byung*/ sa rlung dbu mar 'dus pas nag po 'bang ba sgra gcan gyi nyams 'byung ste/ rin po che nag pa lta bu dang*/ mig gi rnam pa lta bu dang*/ mtshan mo'i sprin dang rmugs pa bzhin nag ling ling ba dang*/ nag bun bun ba dang*/ nag sgor sgor ba dang*/

nag ril ril ba sogs dwangs shing sgrib pa med pa che chung mang nyung ma nges pa kha dog kyang nag po shas che ba'i kha dog ma nges pa sna tshogs 'byung zhing*/ ltos 'gro'i dbyibs dang khro zhal gyi rnam par snang ba kun kyang skabs 'dir 'byung zhes gong ma 'ga' zhig gsung*/ steng phyogs na gnas pa nam mkha'i rlung 'dus pa las mchog gi cha ste/ glog 'od kyi rnam pa 'byung ba ni/ dang po 'od khyug khyug pa dang*/ de nas 'od chem chem pas khyab pa snga ma las yun ring ba dang*/ mthar goms na 'od chem me ba zhig gis khyab pa'i ngang nas 'od phra mo mang po g.yo zhing 'khyug pa 'byung ngo*// de ltar lnga po de rnams (244)thabs kyi phyogs 'byung ba lnga 'dus pa yin pas/ phung po lnga'i rlung 'dus pa zhes bya'o// 'og tu ye shes kyi rlung kyi rlung 'dus pa las thig le'i rnam pa 'byung ste/ kha dog sngon po gtso bo yin kyang gcig tu ma nges pa ste/ kha dog drug po re re dang*/ gnyis ldan drug ldan gyi bar du 'byung zhing*/ thig le'i nang stong pa dang*/ nang thig le rang dang mdog 'dra bas gang ba dang*/ kha dog mi 'dra ba sna tshogs pas gang ba dang*/ dbyibs dang che chung ma nges par 'byung*/ de ltar nyin rtags drug la shas cher mthun par lus nyams 'jam zhing bde ba/ lus yod du mi tshor ba dang*/ dag nyams rlung rgyu ba mi mngon pa tsam dang*/ sems nyams gsal stong rtog med du sing nge ba gnas pa 'byung zhing*/ skabs 'dir g.yang za ba snyam byed pa'i 'jigs pa dang*/ gang yang med snyam pa 'byung zhes kyang gong ma kha cig gsung*/ de ltar rtags bcur grags pa la/ du ba la sogs pa so so'i ming dang rnam pa mthun par 'char ba de la lus nyams sogs thams cad tshang ba go rim nges can du byung na nges pa'i rtags dang phyogs mthun snang ba gzhan 'char bde la ma nges pa'i rtags zhes tha snyad sbyor bar mdzad de/ ma nges pa'i rtags de yang 'di ltar sa rlung dbu mar chud pas ri rab khang khyim la sogs pa dang*/

chu rlung la mtsho dang 'bab chu la sogs pa dang*/ me rlung la me 'bar ba la sogs pa dang*/ rlung gi rlung la 'tshub ma dang ser bu la sogs pa'i snang ba dang*/ nam mkha'i rlung la nam mkha' dang*/ bar snang dang*/ phug stong sogs (245)sbubs stong ba dang*/ ras yug sngon po brkyang pa 'dra ba sogs sna tshogs 'byung*/ gzhan yang sbrang gshog la nyi zer phog pa 'dra ba sogs dang*/ 'ja' 'od phra mo dang*/ skya khyam khyam pa sogs 'bar ba dang zla ba'i rnam pa ci rigs su bsdu ba dang*/ gsor mig lta bu dang sngo ljang sogs nyi mar bsdu ba dang*/ shing sdong gi grib ma 'dra ba dang*/ thag pa srad bu nag po sogs sgra gcan dang*/ sog mda' 'phangs pa 'dra ba kha dog ma nges pa phra mo rgyug pa 'byung ba ni glog dang*/ kha rlangs lta bu dang 'gal me skor ba byed pa lta bu dang*/ bya lding ba 'dra ba sogs thig le'i rigs su gtogs zhes gsung zhing*/ nyams gzhan yang ci rigs pa la/ lus nyams 'gul snying mi 'dod pa dang*/ ngag nyams lce sgyur ba dka' zhing smra mi 'dod/ sems nyams gsal la brtan pa gzhan du mi 'phro ba rnams sa rlung gi byed pa yin/ lus nyams 'jam mnyen shed chung ba/ sems nyams dga' shas che ba la res 'phro rgod thung res ting nge 'dzin bzang na chu khams kyi nus pa yin/ ha cang 'phro rgod che na glod pas phan/ lus nyams khang pa'i nang nas me 'bar ba lta bu dang*/ du bas 'tshubs pa 'dra ba dang*/ shin tu skam dang che ba dang*/ sems nyams blo rgod la rtsub cing spro thung*/ rmi nyams su'ang mes tshig pa sogs byung na me khams kyi byed pa yin/ spro thung ba la'ang glod pas phan/ lus nyams rlung gis khyer ba snyam byed/ nam mkha' la 'gro ba snyam byed/ dngos su 'ong lus gnad ma zhig par (246)ring du 'phar ba 'byung*/ sems nyams su gsal stong shas che/ nam mkha' la lding zhing yod pa snyam byed na rlung khams kyi byed pa yin/ lus nyams lus med par snyam byed cing*/

sems nyams sa rdo ri brag sogs thogs bcas 'di rnams thams cad sangs pa'am cha shas ci rigs ci rigs nas sangs te/ rang nyid nam mkha'i dbyings ya gi na yod pa snyam byed pa byung na nam mkha' khams kyi byed pa yin no// gnyid kyi 'od gsal ni/ dang por gnyid 'thug gi skabs su gsal stong gi nyams skyong thub pa tsam 'ong la/ res 'ga' nam langs pa dang*/ 'od kyis khyab pa snyam byed/ rig pa gsal ba/ khams dwangs ba/ gnyid du ma song ba 'dra ba la sad rgyu yod pa/ sad ma thag mun khang stong gzugs kyis khyab pa dang*/ gzhom med kyi sgra rjes mthun par tshor ba'ang yod/ gnyid la 'gro dus sa la bying ba snyam byed/ 'od khyug khyug pa 'ong*/ rna bar sgra tsi rong gi 'ong*/ 'od gsal ngos ma zin gong du gnyid mi bde ba dang*/ 'dre gnon 'dra ba dang*/ lus sbrid pa 'ong myur du zin pa'i rtags yin/ de nas gsal stong dang rim pas bde ba 'char ro// ma nges pa'i rtags 'di dag sor sdud nas bsam gtan dngos gzhi'i bar du nam yang nges pa med do// khyab par rdo rje 'bebs pas byin gyis brlab pa zhes bya ba dang por sems mi rtog par cung zad gnas shing*/ rtags snang ci rigs par mthong ba nas bzung ste/ sems mi rtog pa la rang shugs su gnas pa'i ngang nas/ lus nyams drag po 'dar ba dang g.yo ba dang 'phar (247)ba dang rgyug pa dang bro gar byed pa la sogs pa dang*/ ngag nyams drag po smra ba dang rgod pa dang du ba dang glu len pa dang sngags kyi tshig dang ku co 'don pa sogs 'byung ste/ dang po gsal la stong tsam gyi ngang nas 'byung la/ phyis ni bde nyams chen po dang bcas te 'byung ba/ de yang mnyam bzhag gi ngang nas byed 'dod rtog pa med par 'byung ste mi rtog pa 'thug pos non pas so// yang rjes thob tu sems nyams sna tshogs pa 'byung ba ni/ dga' ba skyo ba khro zhing 'tshig pa dang rgyug par 'dod pa sna tshogs pa ste 'dod ma dang phyir 'dod ma sum cu rtsa drug po rnams kyi ye shes kyi cha shas babs pa dag yod la/

nyams de thams cad byung rgyal du bskyangs pas gegs dang skyon las rang sar grol nas yon tan gong 'phel du 'gyur ba yin no// de rnams sor sdud dang thun mong ba yin la/ spyir ldog nas nyams myong dang yon tan yar ldan du 'byung bas gong ma rnams la'ang 'di dag thams cad 'byung ngo*// so sor sdud pa'i 'byung ba rnams bshad zin to// de nas bsam gtan bsgoms pas rtags bcu'i tha ma thig le'i nang du rtags gzhan dgu yang re re dang*/ gnyis ldan nas dgu ldan bcu ldan gyi bar du rim gyis 'char bar 'gyur zhing rtags bcu char tshang ba'i thig le de la ni/ thig le chen po'i snang ba zhes bya'o// gzhan yang bsam gtan bsgoms pas sor sdud kyi dus kyi rtags snang gi rgyun rnams chos lnga ldan du 'gyur zhing nges pa kho nar rags pa rnams shin tu phra bar 'gyur ro// des na phal cher la rtags snang thog ma phra rags gang yin yang cung (248)zad mi gsal zhing*/ bar du rags pa gsal ba dang*/ mthar phra zhing gsal ba 'byung ba yin kyang*/ 'ga' zhig la sngar gyi rtags snang rags pa de bsam gtan bsgoms pas phra mor song pa'i mtshams su rtags snang nub te/ sgom stor ba srid pas de la rjes bran du bshad pa'i yid kyi phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor cung zad dang tsam rlung bum can bsres te mi g.yo gsum ldan bsgoms pas rtags snang slar yang shar 'ong la/ sngar gyi rgyun la rtags snang cung zad yod na/ bsam gtan gyi spogs chog bzhin bsgoms pas sor chud 'ong ste/ phal cher la mtshams de nas phra zhing gsal la brtan pa'i rtags snang 'byung ngo*// thig le'i snang ba la dbus su sems gtad na phra bar 'gyur zhing*/ mtha' la gtad na che bar 'gyur ba ni stong gzugs gzhan la'ang rigs 'gre ste/ rags pa la brtan pa ma thob kyi bar du de ltar byas kyang yong ngo*// gzhan yang stong gzugs kyi gsal cha dang spros bral dbyer med de la mnyam par bzhag pas goms pas/

sems gnas na stong gzugs gnas/ sems g.yo na stong gzugs g.yo/ sems gnas rtsa na mthong bya mthong byed tha dad par snang ba mngon gyur 'gags pa ni shes rab kyi yan lag rgyud la skyes pa'i tshad yin/ de'i tshe sems gang du gtad gtad du stong gzugs ci rigs pa re 'char ro// thig le chen po la mnyam par bzhag pas dmar ser la sogs pa kha dog gnyis 'dres kyi rnam pa dwangs shing gsal ba zhig gi dbus su/ dang po dbu phyag la sogs pa sku'i cha shas tsam 'byung zhing*/ de je gsal la lha'i (249)sku'i rnam pa yongs rdzogs su rdzogs pa 'char ro// yang bsam gtan shin tu brtan pa mthar phyin na/ sangs rgyas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku gzugs de yang yul nges pa thig le'i dbus/ dus nges pa mnyam rjes thams cad/ rnam pa nges pa mtshan dpe yongs su rdzogs pa ste/ nges pa gsum ldan du 'gyur ro zhes dang*/ de rjes re khā nag po yang mthong ngo zhes bla ma gong ma 'ga' zhig gsung la/ bdag gi rnam par rtog pa ni/ bsam gtan du mnyam bzhag tu sangs rgyas kyi gzugs mthong ba tsam yin la/ mnyam rjes thams cad du 'chang ba ni sor bsam mthar phyin nas srog rtsol mngon du gyur pa'i tshe 'byung ste/ der byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis mchod ces bya ba la sogs rgyu mtshan du go'o// yang kha cig 'di snyam du/ 'o na rnam pa kun ldan rang sems dang bral ba dag go /zhes pa'i skabs na 'grel par/ gzhan sems ma yin te/ gzhan sems shes pa med pa'i phyir/ zhes re khā nag po'i rtags mthong nas kyang gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes med par bshad la/ bsam gtan mthar phyin na mngon shes lnga kar thob pa yin pas rtags de rnams thams cad sor sdud dam bsam gtan gyi gung yan chad la rdzogs pa yin no// zhe na/ de ni de ltar ma yin te/ spyir stong gzugs 'di rang sems yin te/ gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes med pas kyang shes shing nyams su myong ba'i phyir ro// zhes spyi ldog nas stong gzugs ni bem po dang med bzhin snang ba yin par (250)'dod pas gzhan du bkag zin pas/

shes pa yin par grub pa las shes pa'i nang nas gzhan sems ma yin cing rang sems kyi snang ba yin pa'i sgrub byed du de ltar gsungs pa yin gyi/ sangs rgyas gzugs dang re khā nag po mthong ba'i dus mngon shes med ces pa'i go ba yi rang ma yin no// yang spyir rtags snang thams cad rtags bcur 'dus par sbyor drug gi mkhas grub chen po thams cad bzhed pa bzhin don la gnas la/ de las kho bo cag gi bla ma mkhas grub rgya gar ba 'ga' zhig 'di skad gsung ste/ dper na stong gzugs la ma ga dha'i yul ljongs lta bu zhig mthong ba la/ ljongs de yud tsam mi g.yol/ de nas sangs 'gro na spyin dang 'dra ba ste du rtags rags pa yin/ ri nags grong khyer sogs cha shas rags pa rags pa nas g.yo zhing skye 'jig byed pa ltar snang na du rtags dngos yin/ cha shas phra mo nas g.yo na smig rgyu'i rtags yin/ 'od dang bcas pa g.yo zhing skye 'jig yang yang byed na me khyer gyi rtags yin/ 'od dang bcas te mi g.yo bar 'dug na mar me'i rtags yin/ de rnams gcig gis gcig bsgrib pa'i dbang du byas na/ phan tshun mi bsgribs par dwangs gsal du 'dug na nam mkha'i rtags su bsdu/ des gzhan la'ang rigs 'gre pa yin no gsung*/ de ltar na thog mar dge ba'i 'khrid kyi nyams myong rgyud la skyes pa'i gang zag des ni don dam pa'i bum dbang dngos thob pa yin te/ de bzhin du/ bar dges gsang dbang dang*/ rjes dran gyis sher dbang dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi don dam pa'i dbang bzhi pa dngos thob ces gsungs pa'ang rnam grangs kyi sgo nas de ltar yin (251)la/ spyir ni sor sdud rkyang pa rgyud la skyes pas kyang dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes thun mongs ma yin pa ci rigs par rgyud la skyes pa yin la/ rigs mthun rdzogs pa ni ni ting nge 'dzin mthar phyin pa na'o// bsam gtan gyi rim pa dang 'brel ba rnams bshad zin to// thog mar dge ba'i nyams myong khyad par can skyes pas rtsa bzang ba 'ga' zhig la srog rtsol sgos su ma bsgoms kyang*/

rlung dbu mar chud nas gegs med yon tan phun sum tshogs pa skyes pa'ang yod/ bum pa can ched kyis ma bsgoms kyang rang shugs kyis bum pa can grub pa'ang yod/ gtsug tor du rlung sems 'dus pas rdo rje bslang ba'i bde ba khyad par can thob pa'ang yod/ rlung dbu mar 'dus pa tsam dang rdo rje bslang ba'i nyams phyogs mthun las srog bsdud kyi 'pho ba'i gegs dang 'dzag gegs su 'gyur ba'ang srid/ rtsa 'bring ba man chad la sor bsam gyis de rnams mi 'byung ste/ sor bsam gyi rjes su srog rtsol bsgoms na/ lte bar drod skye/ smin mtshams su bde ba'i zug dang*/ spyi bo za 'khrig g.ya' ba sogs ste/ rlung sbyor ci rigs par sgoms pas gtum mo cung zad 'bar ba'i rtags yin/ me stobs chung*/ thig le stobs che na/ mgo dang mig rus mi bde/ byad sha 'gyur/ langs na mgo 'khor/ me stobs che na 'ga' zhig la 'dzag gegs 'byung nyen yod pa/ rlung sbyor gyis bsal dgos/ rlung dbu mar 'jug tu nye na rtags snang rnams dbang po'i sgo nas 'tshang ba dang*/ ba spu'i sgo nas 'jug pa sogs 'byung*/ me stobs chung ba la rlung gyen du (252)song pas spyi bo'i thig le 'khyags pa'i rtags su rtags sdang nam mkha' la 'khor ba dang gyen du 'gro ba shas che khams ngan par 'gyur/ me stobs che bas spyi bo'i thig le zhu na rlung yang cung zad mar zlog pas rtags rnams kyang phyi nang du thur du 'gro khams bzang bar 'ong*/ bde nyams kyang gong 'phel du 'gro/ rtags snang nam mkhar lding ba de ha cang thal na gtsug tor gyi sgo phug nas 'pho nyen yod pas dbab par bya'o// khyad par nges pa can du rdor bzlas dang 'jam rlung sbrags pas snying tsha mgo bo na smin mtshams 'dus shing bcus pa dang 'khyil pa snyam byed/ sems gsal stong 'od gsal du thim/ 'od kor dang bcas pa'i rtags snang rang gi lus la nye bar 'khor/ gnyid rnams rang sangs la song*/

rlung gi rgyu ba dang rnam pa cung zad mthong*/ mig na gtsug tor za 'khrigs sogs gong du bshad pa bzhin byung na/ rlung dbu mar chug ni thub/ da lta bcing ma thub pa'i rtags nges pa can yin/ de la 'bad rtsol gyis drag por bsgoms na zug gzer rnams snga bas cher 'gro// smin mtshams yan chad sbrid cing med pa snyam byed/ de nas 'od kor rang gi lus kyi nang du 'khor ba 'byung ngo*// spyir 'od kor dma' sa nas langs te/ gyen du drag por 'khor ba de shin tu bzang ba yin no// de yan tshad tsam la bum can gyis dbus mar bcug na 'bebs pa sogs ma byas kyang 'pho ba'i gegs su mi 'gyur ba shas che gsung ngo*// byed bcings log pa'am/ de las kyang thal na rtags snang sangs/ thog pa'i 'du shes nub/ gzugs med bzhi dang phyogs 'dra (253)rung ba'i ting nge 'dzin skye/ 'di skabs dang por dal bus 'bebs mang du byas nas/ mthar 'bebs drag pos phab na srog bsdud kyi gegs sel bar 'gyur/ de las cung zad thal nas brgyal ba ltar song na 'bebs drag po 'ba' zhig gis 'bebs/ 'jug tu 'phar g.yo 'dar sprug smyo 'bog lta bu ring du 'byung pa'i mthar sel 'gro'o// 'pho ba'i gegs 'og tu 'byung ba rnams kyang rim pa 'di kho na dang 'dra bas tshod bzung zhing bsal lo// rdor bzlas la rlung 'jam zhing phra la ring*/ rgyu ba mi tshor/ shes pa gsal/ rmi lam 'jam nyal song*/ stong gzugs gsal zhing 'tsher la phra sil 'gro na yon tan shar ba yin/ 'jam rlung dang rdor bzlas la mnyam rgyu'i skabs su phyir 'gro je thung dang gnas pa je ring bya/ 'jam rlung ma byang bar du ha cang drag na nu ma sbos yong pa dang*/ dal bus ma mnan pang shugs drag na mgo dang ro stod na yong pa'ang srid/ 'jam rlung la lte ba kog kog zer/ spyi bo za/ dpral bar 'bur yong*/ spyi bor bu ga zang thal dod yong ba'ang srid/ re glod cing 'bebs dgos/

goms na mthong snang thams cad ljang mer 'gro/ sku dang thig le ljang khu phra mo dang*/ yon tan 'char tshul snga ma dang 'dra ba las ches bzang bar 'char ro// lus chu lud pa ltar 'phyar ba'i nyams dang*/ rmi ltas ri la 'bab 'dzeg dang*/ 'phur ba dang*/ rta rgyug pa sogs 'byung*/ 'byongs na rmi lam 'jam zhing*/ zin sbyor spel sprul rnam thar sogs shugs las 'byung ngo*// de nas srog rtsol dngos gzhi la/ (254)stong gzugs rags la gsal ba de 'jug dka' ste 'ching bla/ phra zhing gsal ba de 'jug bla ste 'ching dka'/ mi gsal na/ 'jug pa dang*/ 'ching ba gnyis ka la dka' zhing bogs chung ba yin no// rtsub rlung bum pa can bsgoms pas/ rtsa bzang na gegs med par yon tan skye mod kyang phal cher la sdug bsngal gyi nyams re thog mar 'byung bas rlung gcig car 'dun lus rang dbang med par 'dar/ glo bur du drod skye/ nyams rnams khra chem pa dang dmar thing ba'i ngang nas lus 'gyel zhing dran med du brgyal ba sogs 'byung*/ rlung rim gyis 'jug na stong gzugs rang la 'khor/ lus bstums shing bsgril ba 'dra ba dang*/ rlung subs 'gro ba lta bu 'byung*/ de nas cung zad goms pas bde sdug spel mar 'byung ste/ de yang goms na mthar btang snyoms su 'gro/ gong du bshad pa'i rtags snang thams cad 'byung ba'i steng du sa rlung 'chings na/ lus gnad bshig snying mi 'dod rtsub la lci ba dang*/ snang ba ser por snang*/ chu 'chings na grang la mnyen pa dang chu'i snang ba 'char ba shas che/ lar chu la grang dro gnyis ka'ang 'byung*/ me 'chings na drod 'bar zhing me'i snang ba 'byung*/ rlung 'chings na lus yang zhing 'phar ba dang*/ rlung po'i snang ba 'byung*/ nam mkha'i rlung 'chings na/ sngo yam pa dang*/ bde sing ba dang*/ lag (255)pas byug pa sogs ched du reg na ma gtogs lus yod par mi mngon zhing*/ bu ga'i rigs dang*/ bar snang dang*/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams stong par song ba'i snang ba 'byung*/

nam mkha'i nang tshan du ye shes kyi cha la ljang gu dang khra chil ba 'byung ba yod/ de 'dra re re la'ang mthar rtags snang thams cad thig le la 'dus nas lus kyi dbus su thim 'gro na gnad du song ba yin/ de ltar 'byung ba cha mnyam du zhugs na gegs mi 'byung la/ cha ma snyoms na rtsub nyams su 'char te/ de thal na gegs su 'gro/ de yang sa rlung zin na rlung gi stobs zad/ smra brjod mi thub/ g.yo 'gul mi shes pa lta bu dang*/ sa la bying ba dang*/ gzhan gyis mnan pa dang*/ bying rmug la sogs par 'gyur/ me zin na sa'i stobs nyams te/ me char 'bab pa sogs tshig pa'i snang ba dang*/ myul che zhing lus gcig tu mi zug /chu zin na me nyams pas khong 'dar/ grang shum byed/ gangs ri dang rba rlabs kyi gseb tu shor ba snyam 'byung*/ shes pa dran pa mi gsal bkol du mi gtub pa 'byung*/ rlung 'phel na chu nyams te 'gros mgyogs shing lus yang*/ 'gro snying 'dod/ sems bzung kyang mi zin pa yod/ nam mkha' thams cad kyi grogs yin yang*/ nam mkha' kho na 'phel bas g.yangs za zhing skyo shes che bar 'byung*/ de dag kyang phal cher byung rgyal du bskyangs shing*/ lus la nad khams 'phel bar 'dug na gegs sel gyis bcos/ de lam du gsung zhing bskyangs pas gtum mo 'bar ba'i snang ba cung zad 'byung zhing*/ bde (256)nyams gong 'phel du 'gro ste/ 'di skabs 'dir rdor bzlas dang*/ 'jam rlung dang bum can rnams rim can du bsgom pa'i dbang du byas nas bshad pa yin la/ spyir nas rtags rim pa gsum po de rnams rtsa lam byang ba dang*/ dbu ma'i sgor 'dus pa dang*/ dhū tir 'ching ba'i rtags kyi rim pa tsam yin pas bum can lta bu gcig dang po nas mthar yun bsrings te bsgoms pas kyang rtsa lam byang ba dang*/ dbu mar 'dus pa dang*/ der 'ching ba rnams rim pas 'grub pas rtags 'di rnams thams cad yong ngo*// rtsa chad gsos pas dang por mtshon gyis 'bug pa dang*/

sems can gyis rmugs pa 'dra ba'i lus nyams dang*/ lus kyi nang du srog chags rgyug pa 'dra ba'i nyams snang dang*/ dog 'tshang byed pa'i rmi nyams 'byung*/ rtsa chad 'bring po rnams gsos pas bgangs pa 'gril ba 'dar sprug 'phar 'khrig zug rngu dang bcas pa yong*/ rtsa chad phra mo rnams gsos pas/ tsha tseg tseg pa sogs zug chang chung mang po ldang*/ 'di dag gang du 'byung ma nges te/ rtsa chad ci rigs pa gsos pa yin no// de nas bar skabs su btang snyoms dang bde nyams shas che bar 'byung*/ yang bar skabs zhig nas rlung gis rtsa gang ni gang la/ dbyings su thim ma thub pas srog thur 'dres pa'i rlung stobs su gyur te/ gong du bshad pa lta bu bu'i 'pho ba'i gegs shig 'byung nyen yod/ rtags rnams gong du bshad pa dang 'dra zhing*/ rtsa rlung cung zad byang ba'i skabs yin pas 'pho ba dang 'bebs pa gnyis ka sngar las bla'o// bum pa can (257)dbu ma'i nang du nyin zhag gcig 'ching bar nus na nad mtha' dag 'byang zhing tshe la cung zad dbang ba yin la/ yang srog thur 'dres pa'i tshad la phyi rtags 'og rlung kha nang thon na thur sel srog la 'dres/ dri bzang kha snar rngubs pa 'og sgo nas ma nyams par 'thon na srog thur sel la 'dres par zer te/ 'di tsa nang du 'dres pa ni ma yin/ khog nang tsam du phyi la rgyu ba'i srog thur rags pa 'di 'dres pa tsam yin pas rmongs pa ngo mtshar bskyed pa'i rtags tsam yin/ nang rtags steng bzung na 'og 'thems/ 'og bzung na steng 'thems pa yin te/ rtsa nang ci rigs par 'dres pas las snga ma las bzang ngo*// gsang rtags 'bar snang dang bde drod dngos su skye ste ches mchog rtsa dbu mar srog thur 'dres pa yin no// srog rtsol gyi rim pa'i phyed phyi ma'i skabs 'dir srog gzugs phal pa 'grub pa yin te/ snga phyi ni ci rigs su yod do// gzhan yang thig le bzhi'i snang ba las 'khor 'das kyi chos mtha' dag 'char te/

grub mtha' bzhi'i lta ba dang*/ mu stegs byed kyi rgyud bzhi dang*/ rig byed bzhi dang*/ sde pa bzhi dang*/ gsang sngags rgyud sde bzhi la sogs pa'i lha'i snang ba dang*/ sngags kyi snang ba dang*/ tshig don rnam par 'byed pa'i blo gros dang*/ lta spyod sgom gsum gyi nyams mtha' yas pa 'byung la/ dud 'gro mi lha dmyal ba la sogs pa'i gnas su longs spyod kyi snang ba dang*/ bde sdug la sogs pa'i tshor ba dang*/ nyon mongs pa'i khyad par mtha' yas pa snang ste/ sngon gyi man ngag pa rnams la gnas spyod du grags pa dag yin la/ mdor na sems rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba rnam pa thams cad pa yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis shes bya la srid tshad snang ba yin cing*/ des na 'od gsal bde gshegs snying po'i ngo bo ni dus rtags tu gcig car rnam (258)pa thams cad pa yin kyang rnal 'byor pa'i blo yi mthong tshul la rnam pa de dang de 'char pa'i rkyen re dang phrad pa'i tshe snang ba yin pas na sna tshogs pa rnams rim can du snang ngo*// rkyen de yang gang zhe na/ nang gi rtsa rlung thig le'i 'phro 'du'o// sems kyi snang cha nyid rtsa dang rlung dang thig le sna tshogs su snang zhing*/ sna tshogs su snang ba de rnams kyang sems nyid thig le bzhir snang ba la brten nas byang ba yin pas rnam pa thams cad pa'i khongs su rtsa rlung thig le'i 'du 'phrod kyang 'dus pa yin pas de dag rnam pa thams cad pa'i 'char sgo las gzhan du mi bsam mo// 'od kyang kun rdzob rten 'brel snang tshul la bltos nas lus kyi thig le dpral ba nas gnas/ gnyid sad dus kyi snang ba rags pa thams cad des bskyed/ ngag gi thig le mgrin pa na gnas/ rmi lam dang bar do la sogs pa'i snang ba thams cad des bskyed/ yid kyi thig le snying ga na gnas/ gnyid 'thug po dang brgyal ba dang 'chi ba la sogs pa'i gnas skabs thams cad des bskyed/ bzhi pa'i thig le lte ba na gnas/

gnyis sbyor la sogs pa'i chags pa dang*/ yul bzang ngan bar ma gsum la sred cing rmongs pa rnams des bskyed/ de bzhin du rtsa 'khor gzhan la'ang sbyar du yod de/ thig le bzhi bo de nyid dri ma dang bcas pa ni gzhi dus kyi 'khor lo'i zhal bzhi yin la/ sgrib pa phyed tsam dag pa na dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i zhal bzhi dang*/ shin tu sgrib bral gyi gnas skabs su 'bras bu dus kyi 'khor lo'i zhal bzhi'o// rgyud las dus kyi 'khor lo'i zhal bzhi las 'khor 'das thams cad sprul par gsungs pa'i dgongs pa'i gtso bo'ang 'di (259)'di yin la/ der gsungs pa'i bzhi tshan rnams kyis kyang nges par skyed par bya'o// srog rtsol gyi rim pa dang 'brel ba rnams bshad zin to// 'dzin pa'i skabs su rtags thun mong ma yin pa rnams kyi khyad par 'di ltar shes dgos te/ rtags kyi rgyu ni srog thur 'dres pa la brtan pa thob pas gtum mo 'bar rtsa kha thams cad dros/ rtsa thig thams cad glum langs pa ltar khol zhing sang*/ rtsa mdud thams cad mes dral thig le rnams gnas so sor 'bar zhing g.yo/ khams rnams yar mar du 'du zhing steng 'og tu cung zad gang ba rnams yin la/ rtags dngos ni dbu ma'i nang du phra zhing phra ba'i re kha nag po nā da'i rnam pa can dang*/ rta rnga zlum por bkug pa lta bu'i thig le'i rnam pa can 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'bar ba/ re khā phra mo'i nang na rtags bcu kar rdzogs par 'char zhing*/ sku gzugs la sogs pa dag pa dang ma dag pa'i snang ba sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa zhig 'byung ba de yang dhū tī'i nang du gtum mo 'bar ba'i bar snang gi dbus su 'byung ba yin/ gtum mo 'bar ba'i me'i kha dog kyang sna tshogs 'byung la/ re khā yang nag po gtso bo yin pas smos kyi/ gzhan du na kha dog sna tshogs pa'o// des na las 'phro can ma gtog /sor sdud ci la thig le'i dbus su sku gzugs res 'ga' 'char ba dang*/

gzhan yang rim pa dang po gsum la re khā nag po 'dra rung 'char srid kyang ma nges pa'i rtags yin par shes par bya'o// 'dzin pa'i rtogs pa skyes pa'i skabs 'dir srog gzugs khyad par can 'grub pa yin te/ (260)de yang sngar gyi sangs rgyas kyi gzugs brnyan de nyid shin tu brtan par gyur bas stong gzugs dang srog thur gong bu gcig pa'i rlung 'dres pa de blos brtags pa la ma bltos par lha sku mtshan dpe can gyi rnam pa dang por gcig 'char ba nas brtsams te je mang je 'phel du 'gyur/ mdog dbyibs mtshan ma ni ma nges te/ kha gcig la ni rnam pa gcig nyid rtag tu 'char ba'ang yod/ kha cig la ni 'phral 'phral 'gyur bar snang ba'ang yod pa dang*/ spyir phyi nang thams cad du 'char ba yin yang dhu ti'i nang du 'char ba ni mar me lta bu/ gzhan rnams mar me'i 'od lta bu'o// 'di ni srog dbu ma'i thig le la lan gcig thim pa nas 'byung ste mthar brtan pa thob nas las sna tshogs pa 'grub par 'gyur ro// dper na srog dang 'dres pa'i stong gzugs kyi lha de nyid snying gar chu'i dkyil 'khor dang u yig tu gyur te/ lha yab g.yon padma dkar po dang*/ yum g.yon utpal dkar po 'dzin pa/ gnyis ka'ang g.yas mchog sbyin mdzad pa/ glang po ches srung la zhon pa bsgrub bya'i khyim du spros nas zhi rgyas kyi las byed par bsams pas gang blos bsgyur ba der 'gyur te/ stong gzugs de yang de lta bu'i rnam par song ba na snying ga'i bum pa can la 'bad pas/ de ma thag tu zhi rgyas kyi las thogs pa med par 'grub bo// de bzhin du rtsa 'khor dang gdan 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor dang sa bon dang lha'i sku mdog phyag mtshan dang gzhon pa rnam lde kha bsgyur bas las gzhan thams cad 'grub bo// de bzhin du zad par rnams kyang 'grub par bshad do// dper na lte ba'i la yig (261)las sa'i zad pa zam pa lta bu spros te/

lte ba'i bum can la 'bad pas chu bo'am rgya mtsho'i stengs nas mi bying bar 'gro ba la sogs so// nyer 'tshe gzhom pa phra mo gzhan yang bshad do// mgrin par me'i dkyil 'khor ra yig las byung ba'i seng ger gyur zhing*/ seng ge spros pas glang po che rnams bskrad par bsams te/ mgrin pa'i bum can byas na glang po che'i nyer 'tsho bzlog pa la sogs pa dud 'gro gdug pa can rnams dang*/ lha min dang 'byung po skrod par byed pa sogs mdor na phyi nang gi rten 'brel ma nor bar bsgrigs pas bsam pa thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro// skabs 'dir gzhom med nā da'i sgra dbyangs kyang 'byung bar 'gyur te/ dang po dhū tī'i nang du stong pa'i sgra tsam grag pa byung na/ de nyid gong 'phel du song nas sgra drag po 'brug sgra lta bu la sgra gzhan phra mo sna tshogs pas bskor ba lta bu 'byung*/ de nas mi ring ba na dus cig car du srog chags sna tshogs pa'i tshig 'dra ba dang*/ 'byung ba sna tshogs pa'i sgra dang*/ gtam sna tshogs pa dang*/ chos kyi skad sna tshogs pa mang po sgra gcig las grub pa 'byung ngo*// las dang po pas srog 'dzin rjes mthun par sgom pa'i skabs ngag tu me shas che na thig le 'bab pa'i snang ba dang*/ lus drod che ba dang*/ rngul chu 'bab pa ltar 'byung*/ lce'u chung las thig le 'bab pa tshor ba sogs 'byung ste/ 'ga' zhig la 'dzag gegs dang rdul babs drags pas lus stobs 'chor na/ 'gren 'grems dang lus zungs mi 'chor ba'i (262)gdams ngag bya/ 'ga' zhig bde gsal gyi nyams yod 'phro la rlung khams ldang*/ lus grang*/ mgon na thig le 'ju ma thub pa yin/ 'ga' zhig mthong snang gi nyams bzang yang lus sngo zhing skams bde nyams yal/ gzhan gong dang 'dra na thig le rgyas ma thub pa yin/ 'di rigs chags lam gyis bde ba spel bas sel lo// 'dzin pa'i skabs 'dir yang gtum mo'i 'bar snang gis rtsa sgo phye nas srog sdud kyi 'pho ba 'byung ba'i gegs cung zad 'byung ba'i skabs yod kyang*/

rlung sems la ci rigs par dbang thob pas gegs sel gyi gdams ngag phal pa la ma ltos te/ sgrub pa po rang nyid kyis shes par 'gyur ro// srog rtsol mthar phyin nas gegs phal cher las grol zhing*/ 'dzin pa'i phyed snga ma mthar phyin nas sgom gegs kyi ming yang med do// 'dzin pa'i rim pa dang 'brel pa rnams bshad zin to// rjes dran gyi skabs su 'di ltar nges par byed dgos te/ spyir saṃ bu ṭi dang*/ gdan bzhi la sogs pa rgyud sde du ma nas gsungs pa la/ dang por mar me'i mtshan ma dang*/ gnyis pa glog gam mkha' snang gi mtshan ma dang*/ gsum pa rdul phran dkar po'am dkar po'i 'od kyi mtshan ma dang*/ bzhi pa 'dod pa'i lha'i longs spyod kyi mtshan ma dang*/ lnga pa lha'i gzugs kyi mtshan ma dang*/ drug pa gzugs med ye shes kyi mtshan ma dang*/ bdun pa chos kyi dbyings kyi mtshan ma dang*/ brgyad pa bdag nyid sangs rgyas su gyur pa'i mtshan ma ste/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa la mtshan ma brgyad po ni de rnams so// 'di dag la bshad tshul mi 'dra ba ci rigs (263)par yod mod kyang*/ skabs 'dir 'di ltar bshad par bya ste/ mar me'i mtshan ma ni sor bsam gyi dus kyi rtags rnams thams cad de/ yan lag phyi ma rnams la ltos nas rgya shin tu chung ngu zhig gsal bar byed pas so// srog rtsol gyi skabs kyi rtags thams cad ni gnyis pa glog gi mtshan ma ste/ snga ma las rgya che yang mi brtan pas so// gsum pa 'od zer dkar po'i mtshan ma ni 'dzin pa'i skabs kyi mtshan ma thams cad do// der zhu bde 'dzag med grub pas byang chub kyi sems rgyas shing*/ rtsa nang thams cad du thig le 'gro 'ong mthong ba dang*/ phyi ru'ang de'i mthu las zla 'od la sogs pa'i snang ba 'char bas so// bzhi pa la sogs pa bzhi ni rjes dran gyi skabs 'dir 'byung ba yin te/ bzhi pa 'dod pa'i lha'i longs spyod de/ lha 'dod khams pa dang mtshungs par 'dod yon tha mal pa 'di rnams mi 'byung bar/

stong pa nyid kyi gzugs sgra dri ro reg byar 'char zhing*/ de las 'jug shes drug dga' bde khyad par can gyis brlan pa dang*/ lnga pa lha'i gzugs kyi mtshan ma ni/ gzugs khams kyi lha 'od lus su yod pa ltar/ rang nyid stong gzugs kyi lha skur gyur te/ 'od zer dpag tu med par 'phro ba 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi nang du chud pa/ dkyil 'khor mtha' yas pa spro zhing bsdu ba 'byung ste/ stong gzugs kyi lha yab yum grub nas sngar gyi 'dod pa'i longs spyod dang*/ lhag par khams gsum gyi gzugs brnyan thams cad kyis kyang dga' bde bskyed pa'o/ drug pa gzugs med ni/ de nas zhu (264)bde khyad par can skye ste/ gtum mo'i mes rtsa stong phrag bdun bcu rtsa gnyis kyi byang sems thams cad dros thub/ rang gnas su zhu thub/ spyi bor sdud thub/ der shin tu zhu zhing dbu ma'i lam du drangs nas bzung gin bzung gin 'khor lo drug 'gengs nus te/ gtum mo 'bar ba'i nus pa rdzogs shing brtan pa thob na de ltar 'byung gi gzhan mi 'byung ngo*// de yang mnyam bzhag dang rlung stobs kyis rlung dang thig le 'dres pa de nyid zhag gcig dbu mar 'dzin nus na brgyal ba zhes bya ste/ dpral bar thig le 'dzin nus/ zhag bco lnga dbu mar khegs na bcings bzhes bya ste/ mgrin par 'dzin nus/ zla ba gcig tu khegs na bsad pa zhes bya ste/ snying gar 'dzin nus/ zla ba drug tu khegs na bsregs pa zhes bya ste/ lte bar 'dzin nus par rdo rje snying 'grel las gsungs la/ lo gcig khegs na gsang bar 'dzin nus/ rtag tu khegs na nor bu 'dzin nus/ zhes man lung gu ru sogs bla ma gong ma rnams gsung ngo*// de ltar rdo rje nor bur byang chub kyi sems brtan pa'i ye shes de ni/ mchog tu bde ba gzugs med pa// zhes gsungs pa ltar gzugs yid kyi ye shes su ming btags pa yin no// skabs de dang der thig le bzung nus zhes bya ba ni/

khams kyi dwangs ma dang bde ba'i ye shes gnyis gnas de dang der nam du yang mi nyams shing*/ rkyen gang gis kyang g.yo mi thub pa ste/ zhu bde 'dzag med mthar phyin pa'i grub 'bras yin no// zhu bde 'dzag med lhun gyis grub pa ni/ rtsol med du bzhag kyang nor bu las byang sems mi 'dzag par ma (265)zad kyi/ ches gtad phyir phab kyang 'dzag mi thub pa la zer ro// 'khor lo 'og ma 'og ma rnams su babs pa'i skabs kyang gong ma gong ma gang bde nyams pa med cing*/ skad cig skad cig la byang chub kyi sems 'phel bas 'phel ba'i cha gang yin pa de 'og ma 'og mar 'gro zhing gsog par byed cing*/ de la gong ma gong ma'i ro bcud dang ngad dang nus pa'i cha shas yod pas gong ma'i thig le 'og mar so zhes brjod la/ des na 'og mar babs pa'i tshe rtsa 'khor gong ma stong par song ba min cing*/ yar zlog pa'i tshe yang mas rim gyis stong par song ba min pas/ gnas skabs 'di tsam gyi nyams rtogs rgyud la skyes pa'i dga' bzhi lugs 'byung lugs zlog dang*/ las dang po'i dbab zlog gi rim par ni khyad par shin tu che ba yin la/ zhag grangs 'di snyed du khegs zhes gong du bshad pa de rnams kyang mnyam bzhag thun gcig la de tsam du gnas nus la/ de nas lhag par mi nus te/ rtsa 'khor gong 'og gang rung gcig tu 'gro dgos pa'i don yin no// de ltar zhu bde 'dzag med lhun gyis grub pa de thob pa'i rgyu ni gnyis te/ gtum mo 'bar ba brtan pa dang*/ gnas de dang de'i thig les gang ba'o// de yang gtum mo 'bar ba g.yos na snying ga'i nang ma ste rlung gi thig le snying gar gnas pa de g.yo bar byed la/ de gnyis g.yos pas thig le rtsal med du khegs pa mi 'byung la/ gtum mo g.yo ba'i rgyu ni ro rkyang gi rgyu ba yin no// de khegs pas gtum mo brtan/ des snying gi nang brtan/ de (266)gnyis g.yos pas thig le rtsol med du brtan par 'gyur ba yin no// gang bas g.yo med du gnas pa ni bum pa gang ba bzhin no// bdun pa chos kyi dbyings kyi nyams ni zhu bde des rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa chos thams cad kyi chos nyid gnas lugs de dngos su nyams su myong ba snyam byed cing*/

gnas lugs de shin tu gsal bar mtshon par nus pa yin no// brgyad pa bdag nyid sangs rgyas su gyur pa'i nyams ni/ ting nge 'dzin gyi yan lag ste/ sku dang ye shes zung 'jug gi cha shas thob pas/ rang nyid rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su gyur ba dang phyogs 'dra ba'i phyir ro// gzhan yang rjes dran gyi skabs su khams dwangs ma thams cad spyi bor 'dus/ dhū tir la dus me 'bar/ byang sems babs pas phyag chen gyis bcings/ dbu ma thig les gang bas lus kyang thig les gang*/ thig le'i cha shas rdul phran gyi tshad tsam las kyang rtags snang mtha' yas pa 'char ba'i phyir 'khor 'das khams gsum gyi gzugs brnyan dpag tu med pa cig car snang ba rgyun mi chad par 'byung zhing*/ de re res kyang zhu bde dang zhu bde ma yin pa'i dga' bde'i khyad par re 'grub mod kyang*/ bde ba skyed byed gtso bo ni dbu mar gnas pa gtum mo'i rang bzhin las grub pa'i rtags bcu lha sku yab yum gyi rnam pa can rnams te/ gtum mo'i me dang rtags bcu dang*/ srog thur gcig tu 'dres pa'i rlung rnams gzhi gcig la 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'o// dran ting gi skabs dang 'brel pa rnams cung zad bshad zin to// gzhan yang 'dzin pa'i skabs su (267)gtum mo 'bar bcu 'grub tshul dang*/ 'dzin pa nas rjes dran la mtshams sbyor tshul dang*/ rjes dran gyi mgo thob pa tsam nas stong gzugs phyag rgya chen mo 'dod pa'i lha de grub pa yin kyang zhu bde rdzogs par 'dren thub mi thub kyi khyad par dang*/ stong gzugs kyis bde ba 'phel thub mi thub dang*/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba bskyed thub mi thub kyi khyad par dang*/ dga' ba bzhi dang bcu drug gi rab tu dbye ba dang*/ 'dod pa'i gnas skabs bcu rnam par dag pa'i ye shes kyi rim pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin skabs su khams thams cad dwangs ma bcur gyur gyi bar du bzhu gtul byed pa ye shes dag byed dang*/

phung khams dbang yul las dbang bya ba dang bcas pa lha sku shar bas lus dag pa dang*/ las rlung bsang bas ngag dag pa dang*/ byang sems dag pas sems nam mkha' ltar spros pa dang bral yang rtog med kyi rig pas ji lta ba dang*/ ji snyed pa shes tshul dang*/ sa bcu gnyis kyi yon tan sogs mang po bshad du yod mod kyi/ gzhan du shes par bya'o// 'dir ni lam 'di 'bad pas bsgoms na deng sang gi gang zag mang po zhig la'ang 'byung du rung ba'i lus nyams/ ngag nyams/ sems nyams mthong nyams rmi nyams te rtags lngar grags pa nyer mkho che ba rnams gtan la phab pa yin pas/ phyogs mtshon 'di tsam las dpags nas mtha' yas pa'i bar du'ang shes par bya zhing*/ slob dpon nyams myong dang yon tan can gyis ngo sprod par yang bya'o// lam 'di rtags snang gis lam 'khrid pa yin pas rtags tshad shes pa (268)gal che zhing*/ stong gzugs la gces spras dang rtsis po cher byed dgos/ 'on kyang stong gzugs mthong ba tsam gyis mi chog ste/ ngo sprod tshul dang*/ lam du bsrol tshul dang*/ bogs 'don tshul ma nor bar byed dgos so// gang dag 'od gsal stong gzugs la 'khrul snang gi nyams tsam mo zhes smod pa re dag ni/ rgyud sde mtha' yas pa'i don ma go bar lta ba mtho ru re bas g.yang sar lhungs pa yin no// de bas na bla ma dam pa'i man ngag yid bzhin nor bu lag tu 'ongs pa chud ma zos par bya'o// ces pa zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa'i rtags tshad kyi yi ge mdo tsam bkod pa 'di yang rgyal khams pa tā ra na tha'i sug las so//
